selection.min_grid_sun_pct: none: the grid mean cannot see a ridge crest; see the note in this file
selection.note: The grid screens candidates; every figure reported here comes from the full-resolution horizon profile against the ephemeris, the same pass that builds sites.json. Grid visibility values are 18.6 yr means and are kept only for reference.

faults.kept: scarps with at least one mapped point inside the zone grid
faults.meaning: Mapped young thrust faults (lobate scarps). A hazard proxy: proximity to active faults, not a prediction of shaking. No south-polar event catalogue exists.
faults.source: Spatial and temporal distribution of lobate scarps in the lunar south polar region, GRL 2022, doi:10.1029/2022GL098505, Zenodo 6624114, CC-BY 4.0
